integrity: The unrestricted covariance is proved analytically. Exact-arithmetic checks are supplemental and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved under the Yule-Harding-Kingman distribution for n>=2 only; normalizing correlation uses established marginal variance asymptotics. Earlier equivalent research could exist.
title: Exact cherry–cophenetic covariance and rapid decorrelation in Yule trees
